text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital isn't looking well, so I take her to the infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Please excuse me while I get a little rest. Good night…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What the… Where am I? Have I been reborn into another world?!

text_block_list.name: Self A
text_block_list.text: Close! You haven't been reborn, but copied into multiple selves instead!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You're me! Like an actual real copy! And there's more of me over there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait, so all these windows floating in mid-air are showing what the other Digitans are seeing?

text_block_list.name: Self A
text_block_list.text: That's right. So, what's the first thing we should do now that we're more than one?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Easy! Go to an Umamusume concert!

text_block_list.name: Self A
text_block_list.text: Whoa… That way, I can see the performers from multiple angles!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll see the whole venue—from the back to the front and center, from the left seats to the right! Long shots, mid shots, medium close-ups! Ohhhhh, have mercy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And I'll have my own individual view from on stage! First-person multi-angled perspective concerts are the way of the future!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My eyes… I have all the eyes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait, what? Was it all just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But the memory of that concert is still fresh in my mind! Oohoohoo… Time for a replay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital seems to be back in good spirits and full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Let's put one of us on training, one reviewing albums, one perusing my zines, one on homework, one writing manuscripts, one organizing merch… If we split everything up, it'll all be done before you can say Uma!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's see. I'll go to training, and you—

text_block_list.name: Self A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I wanna go train! Then I'll get to sneak glances at all the Umas' fresh faces while I work!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Okay. In that case, I'll switch to writing the manusc—

text_block_list.name: Self B
text_block_list.text: Wait! I'm brimming with pathos that I want to put to the page. Would you let me do it instead?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Agh, why is this so hard to divvy up?! Honestly, I want to do everything!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh… I guess it was a dream…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… I feel like I came face-to-face with my own greed…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After being toyed with in her own dream, Agnes Digital fails to recover.
